Coverage_Description: Basic worldwide hospital & surgical cover (room/board, surgery and related inpatient costs; up to 120 days per disability) with optional modules: inpatient top-up (80% reimbursement above Hospital & Surgical limits; overseas emergency hospitalization only), outpatient clinical (network/non-network), dental care, and annual health check-up
pricing: Annual premium per member (HK$): Hospital & Surgical HS1 3,531, HS2 1,755, HS3 1,107 (if 2-4 employees: HS3 1,359 only); Optional In-Patient Top Up 909/479/403
customer requirement: Hong Kong companies; normally at least 5 employees (2-4 employees only HS3+OP4 and must enroll both)
price structure: Community-rated by benefit level (same premium for same level regardless of age), charged annually per member; dental and health check-up charged on full-year basis
additional informations: 2,000+ medical network providers in Hong Kong/Macau; 24-hour emergency assistance with unlimited medical evacuation/repatriation and hospital deposit guarantee up to HK$39,000; key exclusions include recent pre-existing conditions (within 3 months), AIDS/HIV in first 5 years, and pregnancy-related treatment
